prompt_md: A college's 1,000 students each take one class: nine seminars of 10 and one lecture of 910, so classes average 100. Average class size for a random student?
prompt_short: 9 seminars of 10, 1 lecture of 910. Class size a random student sits in?
hint_md: Ask the students, not the timetable.
explain_intuition_md: The average of 100 counts each class once. But 910 of the 1,000 students sit in the giant lecture, so a typical student experiences a class of 910. Weighting by students instead of by classes pulls the average way up.
